## Take part in an experiment and earn!

The experiment takes approximately **60 minutes**.

All participants are paid a show up fee of **10 € and a bonus of up to 7.7 €**
depending on choices made during the experiment.

To participate, follow the steps below.

For questions, please don't hesitate to contact me at [joona.lohtander@oulu.fi](mailto:joona.lohtander@oulu.fi).

### 1. Join the UbiComp Sona Systems participant pool

Join the [UbiComp](https://ubicomp.oulu.fi/){target="_blank"} Sona Systems participant pool here: [Sona Systems](https://oulu-ubicomp.sona-systems.com){target="_blank"}

Click on 'Request Account' and fill in your information.

### 2. Find a suitable session time

You can find the session times from Sona Systems after registration and book
your session time directly from there.

All sessions are in computer rooms in the Linnanmaa Campus. You can find the available
session times in Sona Systems. Due to renovations in some computer rooms, the exact times will be updated latest on 7.9.

We reserve the right to cancel sessions if an adequate number of participants do
not show up.

### 4. Show up

You do not need to do any preparation before the experiment. For smooth payment,
we ask you to set up MobilePay. If you are unable to do that, please make sure
you have your account details ready.
